posts.name: PlatinumWarlock
posts.cooked:
So, in addition to the two Environments for the Vengeance expansion, the >G guys have also posted the write-ups for the Vengeful Five, which include an update to Baron Blade.

In the write-up, it seems that he's been able to (at least partially/temporarily) create a serum that provides him strength, endurance, and power on the level of his nemesis, Legacy.  

So, gang--what are the implications for the rest of the Sentinels world going forward?  Is this serum what drives Blade mad, causing him to kill Pauline?  Or is it what finally allows him to best Legacy himself?  How is that serum (and its exhaustion aftereffect) going to be represented mechanically?

posts.name: Drakossozh
posts.cooked:
Baron Blade has always been my favorite among all the Villains. His difficulty level spans a beautiful range, from teaching levels to just enough of a challenge to keep him interesting. Notably, he hasn't reached the "ASDFGH *table flip*" levels associated with the hardest villains (up to today, I am still hesitant to pull out Matty or The Chairman if I want to have a simple good time.), which is perfect by me. He also has the best thematic-mechanic correlation of them all in my opinion, so now I am mega-excited for the new Baron Blade! Powers? Yes please!

 

Also, I am very much amused that Baron Blade uses letters as a primary means of communication with other baddies. You'd think that a scientifically, technologically gifted genius would be able to work facebook or email or something, but pen and paper was the way to go. Classy, is what it is. But can you imagine the mailman's face?
